				<article id="post-31" class="entry content-bg single-entry post-31 page type-page status-publish hentry">
	<div class="entry-content-wrap">

<div class="entry-content single-content">

<p></p>

<div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id31_b38175-f0 alignnone kt-row-has-bg wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-1-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-middle kb-theme-content-width">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column31_2967e7-8e inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col"></div></div>

</div></div>

<div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id31_79962d-64 alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-1-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-top">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column31_62698e-cd inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h1 class="kt-adv-heading31_5ae051-e6 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading31_5ae051-e6">Kitesurfing  in Naxos</h1>

<div class="wp-block-kadence-spacer aligncenter kt-block-spacer-31_1fd516-fa"><div class="kt-block-spacer kt-block-spacer-halign-center"><hr class="kt-divider"/></div></div>
</div></div>

</div></div>

<div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id31_cda294-d2 alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-2-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-middle">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column31_af45dd-6a inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<figure class="wp-block-kadence-image kb-image31_3bff23-ba size-full kb-image-is-ratio-size"><div class="kb-is-ratio-image kb-image-ratio-port34"><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="507" height="828" src="https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/kite-instructor.webp" alt="kite instructor" class="kb-img wp-image-125" srcset="https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/kite-instructor.webp 507w, https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/kite-instructor-184x300.webp 184w" sizes="(max-width: 507px) 100vw, 507px" /></div></figure>
</div></div>

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column31_c73f42-c9 inner-column-2"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col"><div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id31_e99e97-e6 alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-1-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-top">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column31_24fdbc-6c inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h5 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Beginner to advanced we got you covered</h5>

<p>At the beginning, you will learn flying the kite on the beach with your qualified kitesurfing instructor until you feel confident to proceed to our radio assisted deep water plan. If you feel rusty, tailor-made refresher courses are available for you.</p>

<p>Our kitesurfing plans are taught privately, semi-privately or in a group. All students are provided with the latest kitesurfing gear, wetsuits, harnesses, impact vests and helmets.</p>

<p>Safety comes first. Your safety is our biggest concern, you don’t have to be worried during your session, a rescue boat is always stand by. All the kitesurfing instructors are certified by IKO International Kiteboarding Organization and by the end of all your kitesurfing session you will receive the official IKO  student card that certifies your level.</p>

<p>Our kitesurfing plans are designed to prepare you to be a fully independent rider. Your kitesurfing instructor will take you through each stage of learning at your own pace. Our teaching system is divided into three primary sections.</p>
</div></div>

</div></div></div></div>

</div></div>

<div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id31_15c89e-23 alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-1-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-top">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column31_a39495-14 inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h5 class="kt-adv-heading31_f765c6-76 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading has-theme-palette-4-color has-text-color" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading31_f765c6-76"><strong>From beginner to advanced, Naxos it is one of the best places to learn to kitesurf or progress regardless of your current level!</strong></h5>
</div></div>

</div></div>

<div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id31_827aa6-8e alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-2-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-middle">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column31_18e264-3b inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col"><div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id31_1f1282-76 alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-1-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-top">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column31_8cf55d-51 inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h5 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Kite Control</h5>

<p class="has-text-align-left">At first you will start on the beach. In this step, you will learn about wind principles, safety procedures, to set up the kite and how to fly the kite. <br>After having a good control you will pass to the following level.</p>
</div></div>

</div></div></div></div>

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column31_85a6ec-b5 inner-column-2"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<figure class="wp-block-kadence-image kb-image31_0e1383-70 size-large kb-image-is-ratio-size"><div class="kb-is-ratio-image kb-image-ratio-port34"><img decoding="async" width="986" height="1024" src="https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/20220724_084918-2-986x1024.jpg" alt="20220724 084918 (2)" class="kb-img wp-image-126" srcset="https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/20220724_084918-2-986x1024.jpg 986w, https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/20220724_084918-2-289x300.jpg 289w, https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/20220724_084918-2-768x798.jpg 768w, https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/20220724_084918-2-1478x1536.jpg 1478w, https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/20220724_084918-2.jpg 1540w" sizes="(max-width: 986px) 100vw, 986px" /></div></figure>
</div></div>

</div></div>

<div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id31_3d4d67-c3 alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-2-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-middle">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column31_c85509-19 inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<figure class="wp-block-kadence-image kb-image31_349b30-14 size-full kb-image-is-ratio-size"><div class="kb-is-ratio-image kb-image-ratio-port34"><img decoding="async" width="504" height="600" src="https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/401c54_5f7eac71fd034b7f87d69b73b7b2ae69_mv2.webp" alt="401c54 5f7eac71fd034b7f87d69b73b7b2ae69 mv2" class="kb-img wp-image-127" srcset="https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/401c54_5f7eac71fd034b7f87d69b73b7b2ae69_mv2.webp 504w, https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/401c54_5f7eac71fd034b7f87d69b73b7b2ae69_mv2-252x300.webp 252w" sizes="(max-width: 504px) 100vw, 504px" /></div></figure>
</div></div>

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column31_639520-6c inner-column-2"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col"><div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id31_27ab23-10 alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-1-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-top">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column31_3ca067-8f inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h5 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Bodydraging</h5>

<p>It is time to go into the water. Using the kite principles that you learnt in your first kitesurfing session, you will now use the kite to drag your body through the water. You will learn other core skills such as launching and landing, board recovery and water safety.</p>
</div></div>

</div></div></div></div>

</div></div>

<div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id31_067083-33 alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-2-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-middle">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column31_9e5cc0-ca inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col"><div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id31_149526-e6 alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-1-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-top">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column31_78dac4-10 inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h5 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Waterstart</h5>

<p class="has-text-align-left">It is kite time. After you understand the principles and you are in good control of the kite, it is time to get on the board. This may be trickier than you originally imagined, but it is all fun and once you have done it; there is not better feeling of satisfaction and accomplishment.</p>
</div></div>

</div></div></div></div>

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column31_f3dbc2-aa inner-column-2"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<figure class="wp-block-kadence-image kb-image31_25c81d-3c size-full kb-image-is-ratio-size"><div class="kb-is-ratio-image kb-image-ratio-port34"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="400" height="600" src="https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/IMG_4948-2.jpg" alt="img 4948 2" class="kb-img wp-image-128" srcset="https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/IMG_4948-2.jpg 400w, https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/IMG_4948-2-200x300.jpg 200w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 400px) 100vw, 400px" /></div></figure>
</div></div>

</div></div>

<div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id31_f7a88d-fc alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-1-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-top">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column31_23aef9-a7 inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col"><div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id31_9629cf-4d aligncenter wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-3-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-top kb-theme-content-width">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column31_222a3f-39 inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h3 class="kt-adv-heading31_2e39d1-3b wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading31_2e39d1-3b">Private Course</h3>
